notices.issuer_name: Servicio Nacional de Geologia y Mineria (Sernageomin)
notices.obligation_basis: regulator's formal suspension order over underground operations after a fatal collapse, with reports required before it would evaluate lifting (regulatory action; record calls it a 'formal suspension')
notices.summary: Formal suspension of underground operations at El Teniente plus instruction that Codelco present four reports (cause analysis, recovery plan, fortification assessment, structural evaluation) before lifting is evaluated; date ambiguous in the record (scorer_note 'evening of 31 July', evidence knowable_from 2025-08-01, article 2025-08-04), see notes.

notices.issuer_name: Labour Directorate (as named in the record)

notices.summary: Approval alongside Sernageomin, reported in one sentence with N2, to restart eight of twelve underground sectors on 9 August; may be one joint approval with N2 (see notes).

notices.issuer_name: Corporacion Nacional del Cobre de Chile (Codelco)

rows.notes: Clock is events.event_date 2025-07-31 (re-run of voided row 12, whose clock was 2026-07-31). Nodes: event node el_teniente_copper_supply; touched_set nodes el_teniente_copper_supply and codelco_capex_programme. DATE AMBIGUITY on R13-N1: the map call's scorer_note dates Sernageomin's suspension 'on the evening of 31 July' (the clock date), call 2's scorer_note says 'within a day', the evidence row's knowable_from is 2025-08-01 and the article is dated 2025-08-04. I dated it 2025-08-01 (the evidence row's date); if the orchestrator dates the order 31 July it falls under before_clock. The record does not separate the suspension from the four-report instruction, so they are one notice. R13-N2 and R13-N3 come from one UPI sentence ('approval from Sernageomin and the Labour Directorate'); they may be one joint approval and can be merged. Codelco is unlisted (holders.listed=0), so no exchange rule applies to it; R13-N5 rests on the scorer_note's mention of bond-market disclosure duties. Record limits: the ledger holds no accident notification, no exchange or securities-regulator filing, no force majeure or allocation notice, no contractor notice and no Codelco or Sernageomin primary document; every notice reaches the record through press (Reuters, UPI, Mining.com, BHRRC). Links deliberately not made: res 01a081ba-79d5-742e-817d-fdeeb7dbef23 (null call, thin coverage, about orders beyond the site) is not linked to R13-N1/N2, which are orders at the site; res 01a081ba-79d5-742e-817d-fdecbed702c0 (Codelco states a stoppage) bears only on the 31 July stoppage statement listed under excluded. All evidence rows for this round have carrier = null. The database was opened immutable, so uncheckpointed WAL frames are invisible; the export's evidence and resolutions matched the database row for row (11 evidence, 11 resolutions).

rows.notes: Clock is events.event_date 2026-08-06. Event node us_display_glass_imports; touched_set nodes us_display_glass_imports and us_display_downstream_assembly. The event itself (the Limited Exclusion Order and the Cease and Desist Order) is dated on the clock and so is excluded as before_clock; the only dated document in the record that postdates the clock is the 13 August public version of the parallel trade-secrets initial determination, and it is doubtful for three reasons: it belongs to a different investigation from the event's (the same respondents and node; round intake Q1b describes it as an active parallel dispute on the same node), the determination itself is dated 24 July, and the record does not show the 13 August date was uncalendared. The record for this row is thin: 6 evidence rows, all press, law-firm or counsel write-ups apart from one 2025 USITC news release; it holds no filing by Corning, IRICO or any downstream company, no CBP instrument, no Federal Register item and no Presidential-review notice. Corning's IR feed and CBP's rulings database were not read directly (calls resolved with thin coverage), so absence from the record is not absence in the world. Only res 01a082bb-f6d6-7296-9fe2-20bab19daf6d (thin) is linked to R15-N1, because its scorer_note cites the parallel case's orders 'described as taking effect in January 2027'; the map call's resolution (adequate) bears on the 6 August order, which is excluded. The database was opened immutable; the export's evidence and resolutions matched the database (6 evidence, 9 resolutions).
